remarks: Welcome to Schooner Cove, a beautifully landscaped waterfront community with a private marina in the Shippan area of Stamford. This classy ground-floor unit with gorgeous LVT floors throughout has been tastefully and stylishly updated. The kitchen showcases stainless steel appliances, under cabinet lighting and quartz countertops, and flows effortlessly into the dining area and spacious living room. The living area, with a cozy wood-burning fireplace and ceiling to floor windows is an inviting place for relaxing and entertaining. A dry bar and automated window shades are a wonderful addition to this space. A slider door from here to a private patio is also a wonderful spot for morning coffee The main level boasts a generously sized bedroom with a private and renovated ensuite bath, along with a convenient half bath and laundry facilities. Upstairs, there is an additional bedroom with another ensuite bathroom. Schooner Cove also has a gated swimming pool with toilets and picnic tables. Heat and water are included in the monthly rent. Come and enjoy a hassle-free waterfront living experience.
